intro.summary: Northwest community along Bowness Road and the Bow River, a former town annexed in 1963, with steady single and semi-detached infill.
intro.body: Montgomery sits on the north bank of the Bow River along Bowness Road and 16 Avenue NW, next to Shouldice Athletic Park. It was a separate town until Calgary annexed it in 1963. Its 1950s homes on wide lots are frequently replaced by semi-detached pairs and new single-detached houses.
